transcript.message: Ready when you are. Count it off and lift. Is the tree down safely? What did the cart do?

*I give the crew a firm nod and count them through the lift, guiding the pot clear of the cart without letting it tip. Once the tree is set upright in a safe, visible spot, I turn back to the wheels and linkage.*

“It’s down safely. The cart has stopped bracing now the tree is clear—look, the wheels have eased back.”
